author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Figure with a round head, a shoulder line running straight out into a level arm bent down at the hand, a chest panel band and a lower body tapering to the ground, as in the reference. The current drawing broke the body into three detached boxes and a hook, so the arm and panels did not read as one figure.
omissions: Two chest panels instead of three (the 18-wide torso fits one divider at 8 spacing); the panels' wiring is omitted.
